bio: 183 Wildboi is a CWI catalog artist. CWI's Rock-Rap Revival identifies Black as co-producer on the core catalog, with priority tracks Stunt (2024) and Full Moon (2022), both CWI — Full Moon has 24,293 plays. Public verification of the co-production credits is still pending. The album Sorry For The Heartbreak is on WildLyfe Records, not CWI, and is excluded from the CWI catalog.
